caption:
Homeowners don't hire the best contractor.

They hire whoever answers first.

Response speed beats price and reviews almost every time. The first business to reply usually gets the job, no matter who has the better rating.

Most shops never get the chance to compete on quality. Few contractors track how fast they respond, and most take hours instead of minutes.

Run this test this week: have someone outside your business submit a lead or leave a missed call, then time your real first response. Most owners are shocked by their own number.

The platform texts every missed call and new lead back automatically, in seconds.

rationale: Leads with a sharp, universally true insight about speed beating quality and price in service businesses, then gives a concrete, doable self-test with no fabricated statistics, tying directly into the platform's automated missed-call and lead text-back capability.
